subject: Atticus Health — post-demo fitline recap & benchmark links
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@atticushealth.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco@atticushealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Atticus Health — post-demo fitline recap & next steps

Hi Ellen / Marco,

Great to meet you both earlier — thanks for a thoughtful demo and for walking us through the triage flows and clinician review path. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side: 

1) What we heard
- Primary constraints: sub-200ms p50 response for short prompts (UI snippets) and consistent throughput during end-of-day batch ingest.
- Quality bar: >92% intent/slot accuracy on clinician prompts in your eval set; high sensitivity for clinical entity extraction.

2) Redwood recommendations (pilot scope)
- Pilot target: 2-week sandbox (non-PHI) with 250k tokens/day synthetic load, focused on the high-frequency triage path.
- Models we recommend for the pilot: redwood-compat-7b (fast, cost-conscious), redwood-flare-13b-quant (best quality with 8-bit quant), redwood-alpha-3b (low-latency microservice).

3) What I attached/shared
- atticus-promptset-v1.csv — representative prompts we used in the demo (you can expand).
- Demo recording (atticus-demo-recording.mp4) — short clips of the session.
- Beta perf dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/perf/atticus/v1 (Redwood-verified profiles + raw traces).

4) Next steps
- If you’re open: we’ll provision a sandbox tenant and run the two-week pilot using your promptset (or ours if you prefer) and share the full TPS/latency breakdown + quality regressions at the end.
- Can we lock a start date? Week of Oct 18th would give us enough time to finalize the SOW.

Questions for you before we spin up: any restrictions around sample data sharing (even synthetic) and preferred contact for procurement?

Thanks —
Soojinn (cc Jordan + Marissa)

--
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Thanks Soojin — helpful summary. A few clarifying items from our side before we commit to a pilot:

- SLA: can you share the expected p99 tail for the three model options at our target throughput? We have strict UI timeouts for clinician flows.
- Data handling: we cannot send PHI to external vendors. For the sandbox, can you confirm synthetic-only and whether logs will leave our VPC?
- Cost estimate: rough monthly cost for productioning the 13b-quant model at 250k tokens/day (ballpark).

Also, can you include one consolidated performance table (TPS, p50, p95, p99) for each recommended model so our infra and product leads can sign-off quickly?

Happy to meet Wed 10/14 at 11am PT to go over details — Marco will join procurement.

Ellen
Director, Clinical Technology
Atticus Health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Atticus Health — post-demo fitline recap & benchmark links (table included)

Ellen — thanks, great questions. Below is a concise Redwood-verified performance snapshot for the three models we recommended. The numbers are from our hosted benchmark harness using your promptset (anonymized + synthetic augmentations) and a realistic arrival process that simulates end-of-day spikes. Links to raw traces are at the bottom.

Redwood-verified performance profiles (pilot config: 250k tokens/day synthetic; sequence avg 64 tokens)

Model | Peak TPS | p50 latency (ms) | p95 latency (ms) | p99 latency (ms) | Notes
------|----------|------------------|------------------|------------------|------
redwood-compat-7b | 24 TPS | 92 ms | 185 ms | 280 ms | Good cost/perf; solid for UI microcalls
redwood-alpha-3b | 48 TPS | 48 ms | 120 ms | 200 ms | Lowest tail, recommended for strict latency paths
redwood-flare-13b-quant | 12 TPS | 155 ms | 320 ms | 520 ms | Best semantic quality; consider for complex clinician summaries (costly)

Estimated monthly token cost (rough)
- redwood-compat-7b: ~$2,400/month at 250k tokens/day
- redwood-alpha-3b: ~$4,800/month
- redwood-flare-13b-quant: ~$11,200/month

Notes on SLAs/data:
- p99 commitments require Dedicated capacity; for hosted we provide fallback routing and cold-start protections but cannot commit to p99 without reserved pools.
- For the sandbox pilot we will only use synthetic prompts and redact any customer PII; logs for the sandbox will be accessible via a scoped project dashboard but we can keep full logs within your VPC if you prefer Redwood Private.

Attachments and links
- atticus-promptset-v1.csv (attached) — the prompts used for these profiles.
- Pilot scope doc: pilot-scope-MVP.pdf (attached).
- Dashboard (profiles + traces): https://dash.redwood.ai/perf/atticus/v1
- Raw traces (trace ids): https://dash.redwood.ai/perf/atticus/v1/traces?run=2026-10-11-1

Quality/regression guardrails (recommended)
- Run nightly evals against a fixed holdout (we can run this for you and push alerts to Slack).
- Automate a gating check: if semantic similarity drops >4% vs baseline on the clinician set, trigger a rollback to a verified snapshot.
- Use lightweight prompt-level filters for hallucination-prone templates (examples in the attached promptset).

If that looks good I’ll schedule the sandbox and loop in Ben to confirm deployment and SOW details. Wed 10/14 11am PT works for us — I’ll send a calendar invite.

Regards,
Soojinn
